svg.title: 02 information boundary
svg.desc: Two prediction questions and a student-accessible population definition of temporal innovation. Existing cached target is contextual.

g.text: Measure teacher information accessible to the student
RGB complementarity and skeleton-only temporal learning are separate questions.

stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(3%,49%,54%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: EXISTING QUESTION
RGB prefix + support -> contextual future Y
Does adding skeleton history improve prediction?

rect.style: stroke: rgb(80%,85%,89%); stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;
stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1.2; fill: rgb(47%,32%,64%); fill-rule: evenodd;

g.text: NEW DEVELOPMENT QUESTION
Current posture + support -> contextual future Y
What does ordered skeleton history add?

Coordinates, quality and timing
Observed frames 0-31 only

Frozen contextual features
